title: MonoDreams module manifest
description: A module is a self-contained, copyable slice of the MonoDreams engine. Manifests describe the files, dependencies, NuGet packages, csproj/.mgcb edits, and post-install guidance the CLI applies when a user runs `monodreams add <module>`.

$schema.description: Pointer to this schema. Conventionally `../module.schema.json` relative to the manifest.

name.description: Module identifier, kebab-case. Must match the directory name under `registry/`.

description.description: Single-line summary shown by `monodreams list`. No trailing period.

platforms.description: Target platforms this module supports. Omit (or list both) for a platform-agnostic module — the default is all platforms. Restrict it only when a module cannot work on a backend (e.g. a desktop-only debugging overlay). The CLI skips the module for a project whose target platform is not listed here. Platform values match the `$(MonoDreamsPlatform)` MSBuild property: `desktop` (MonoGame.Framework.DesktopGL) and `web` (nkast.Xna.Framework / KNI BlazorGL).

dependencies.description: Other modules this module requires. Resolved transitively at install time.

platforms.description: Platforms this package applies to. Omit for a platform-agnostic package (pure .NET, no MonoGame ref — e.g. YarnSpinner, CsvHelper, DefaultEcs). Tag it when the package is a backend-specific binary: list one platform here and its counterpart as a sibling entry tagged with the other (e.g. `MonoGame.Framework.DesktopGL` for `desktop` and `nkast.Xna.Framework.Blazor` for `web`; `MonoGame.Extended` for `desktop` and `KNI.Extended` for `web`). The CLI injects only the entries matching the project's target platform.

nugetDependencies.description: NuGet `<PackageReference>` entries the CLI injects into the user's csproj. Platform-specific packages (the MonoGame/KNI backend, MonoGame.Extended/KNI.Extended) are tagged per-platform via each entry's `platforms`; untagged entries apply to all platforms.

csprojProperties.description: Properties the CLI adds to a `<PropertyGroup>` in the user's csproj. Keys are MSBuild property names, values are their text content.

source.description: Path relative to the engine repo root (this repo). Read by the CLI when copying.

destination.description: Path relative to the user's project root where the file lands. By convention mirrors `source` so namespaces and the on-disk path stay aligned.

kind.description: `code` — C# source (default). `asset` — non-compiled resource, copied as-is. `tool` — supporting script (e.g. an editor/exporter plugin) dropped under `Tools/`.

files.description: Optional override of the implicit file list. By default the CLI copies every file inside `MonoDreams/<module-name>/` (except `module.json` itself); use this only when a module needs to ship a file from outside its own directory.

oneOf.description: A complete MGCB statement applying to all platforms (e.g. `#begin Fonts/...`).

platforms.description: Platforms this content-pipeline line applies to. Omit for a backend-agnostic line. Tag it when the importer/processor or `/reference:` path differs by backend (the desktop content build uses MonoGame's pipeline assemblies; the web build uses the matching KNI ones).

mgcbEntries.description: Lines the CLI appends to the user's `.mgcb` file (Content pipeline). Each entry is either a complete MGCB statement string (applies to all platforms) or an object `{ value, platforms }` for a content-pipeline line that differs per backend. The CLI appends only the entries matching the project's target platform.

postInstallNotes.description: Markdown printed to the terminal after install. Use it for `Logger.Initialize(...)` calls, asset hookups, system pipeline order — anything a human or an AI agent needs to wire the module into their screen.

agentsMd.description: Optional path (relative to the manifest) to an AGENTS.md snippet. When present, the CLI appends it to the user's project-root AGENTS.md so AI agents inherit the module's invariants.

premisesRef.description: Path relative to the module manifest, pointing at the `premises.md` for this module. Conventionally `docs/premises.md` (each module ships its own `docs/` subfolder). Surfaced by `monodreams list --verbose` so users and agents know where the invariants live.

demo.description: Optional working demonstration of the module. Files live under `<module>/demo/` and only ship when the user installs with `--with-demo`. The MonoDreams.Demos host project compiles these directly so they can reference shared menu UI.

entry.description: Fully-qualified class name of the IGameScreen the demo exposes (e.g. `MonoDreams.Demo.Camera.CameraDemoScreen`).

description.description: One-line summary of what the demo shows. Surfaced in the launcher screen and by `monodreams list --verbose`.

dependencies.description: Additional modules the demo needs beyond the owning module's `dependencies` (e.g. `ui`, `cursor`, `rendering-text` for menu chrome). Installed only when the user passes `--with-demo`.
